tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description uses imperative phrasing ('Use when a customer reports...'), focuses on triggering contexts (ingest failures, egress errors, 401/403/SigV4, latency, CDN auth, harvest failures), explicitly calls out when NOT to use it (encoder-side, ad-insertion, CloudFront edge issues), and is concise despite covering a broad surface area. It lists many trigger scenarios without naming the domain directly, which is appropriately pushy.
tests.evidence: Use when a customer reports a MediaPackage problem or when evidence points at the packaging/origin layer: ingest failures or 401/403/SigV4 errors, egress 4xx/5xx, player 404s, origin latency...
